messages:
ana: We keep rebuilding the same export access flow. I'd like a standard 'ephemeral-export' template (RBAC + KMS + scrub rules + retention defaults) so infra PRs are smaller. Thoughts?
bryce: +1. Template should default to: SALT in vault, email redacted, user_id=sha256+salt, ip=/24 mask, remove tokens, ephemeral HSM key, pre-signed URL 4h, snapshot retention 24h unless compliance requests longer.
sec-bot: policy reminder: templates must include required approvers (auditor + oncall or 2 approvers), audit hooks (grant/decrypt/download/delete), and an auto-delete lifecycle. Missing items block automated approvals.
oncall-rita: oncall ok with that flow. require MFA for unwrap and an attestation checkbox in the ticket. Also add per-export reason field to audit events.
kms-ops: KMS guidance: prefer ephemeral HSM keys for triage; if compliance needs >48h decrypt windows then require CISO signoff and a scoped CMK. Template should include a key_policy placeholder and guidance for key origin, expiry, and principal restrictions.
infra-lee: i'll sketch an infra PR and a repo template that populates role ARNs, resource-scoped policies, and S3 presigned flow. CI will lint PRs to ensure no broad "siem:*" permissions and that exports to ephemeral destinations don't write to long-term buckets.
bryce: add default scrub rules and an example query plus the sample curl/aws command to reduce back-and-forth with auditors.
nana: (typo) ignore
ana: wait ignore previous, typo.
ana: ignore
ana: also require SALT lifecycle: store per-export in vault and auto-rotate after delete. Ensure SALT never appears in code or PR diffs; put vault reference in ticket.
sec-bot: draft template submitted to docs PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4120 for review. Template includes example key_policy, scrub rules, approval checklist, CI lint entries, and sample commands.
kms-ops: will add a KMS runbook section showing how to request ephemeral HSM keys and the minimal key_policy for timeboxed decrypt grants.
infra-lee: opening infra PR for role template and CI linter: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3201. reviewers: @sre @seceng.
oncall-rita: approved in principle; final signoff gated on auditor acceptance and that SALT vault path exists.
bryce: tagging auditor in the docs PR for signoff. once approved, we can land and start using the template. saves ~30m per export request.
sec-bot: checklist: docs PR created, infra PR created, auditor pinged. track follow-ups in TICKET-EXPORT-TEMPLATE.
nana: closing thread - i'll consolidate feedback and attach the template to the export runbook.
